title.narrative: SWITCH: Turning the principles of Human Rights and Democracy into everyday life and practices for the people of Gaza

description.narrative:
Overall objective (OO): Overall Objective: To contribute to the strengthening of Palestinian civil society¿s role in promoting and protecting human rights and fundamental freedoms

Specific Objective: To enhance the capacity of Gazan civil society actors in safeguarding fundamental freedoms.

O1: The technical capabilities of human rights defenders, change-makers and CSO leaders is improved, as well as their access to information, through Pal-Think¿s community-based Academy.

O2: The institutional and organisational capacity of CSOs in Gaza is enhanced to implement their mandates, and actively engage in monitoring the respect for human rights in their communities.O3: The capacity of traditional and new media in Gaza to monitor duty bearers and inform citizenry on HR is enabled.
